scripts.sample: AM_OP=listDir; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; command -v toybox >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo __AM_NO_TOYBOX__; exit 0; }; AM_R=$(toybox readlink -f "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$AM_R" ] && AM_P="$AM_R"; if [ ! -d "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_NOT_A_DIR__; exit 0; fi; toybox find "$AM_P" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec toybox stat -c '%F|%s|%Y|%n' {} + 2>/dev/null; exit 0

AM_OP=findFiles; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; if [ ! -e "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_MISSING__; exit 0; fi; toybox find "$AM_P" -type f -exec toybox stat -c '%s|%n' {} + 2>/dev/null; exit 0

AM_OP=findDirs; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; if [ ! -e "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_MISSING__; exit 0; fi; toybox find "$AM_P" -type d -exec toybox stat -c '%Y|%n' {} + 2>/dev/null; exit 0
AM_OP=statMTimes; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; if [ ! -e "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_MISSING__; exit 0; fi; toybox find "$AM_P" -exec toybox stat -c '%Y|%n' {} + 2>/dev/null; exit 0

AM_OP=statFS; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; command -v toybox >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo __AM_NO_TOYBOX__; exit 0; }; toybox stat -f -c '%a|%b|%S' "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null || echo __AM_STAT_FAILED__; exit 0

AM_OP=md5One; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; if [ ! -e "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_MISSING__; exit 0; fi; if [ -d "$AM_P" ]; then toybox find "$AM_P" -type f -exec toybox md5sum {} + 2>/dev/null; else toybox md5sum "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
AM_OP=md5Batch; for AM_P in '/sdcard/a b.jpg' '/sdcard/o'\''clock.mp4'; do toybox md5sum "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; done; exit 0
AM_OP=rmOne; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; rm -rf -- "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; if [ -e "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_DELETE_FAILED__; fi; exit 0
AM_OP=rmBatch; for AM_P in '/sdcard/a b.jpg' '/sdcard/o'\''clock.mp4'; do rm -rf -- "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; if [ -e "$AM_P" ]; then printf '__AM_DELETE_FAILED__|%s\n' "$AM_P"; fi; done; exit 0
AM_OP=rmdirBatch; for AM_P in '/sdcard/a b.jpg' '/sdcard/o'\''clock.mp4'; do toybox rmdir -- "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; if [ -d "$AM_P" ]; then printf '__AM_NOT_EMPTY__|%s\n' "$AM_P"; fi; done; exit 0
AM_OP=mkdir; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; mkdir -- "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; if [ ! -d "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_MKDIR_FAILED__; fi; exit 0
AM_OP=mkdirP; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; mkdir -p -- "$AM_P" 2>/dev/null; if [ ! -d "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_MKDIR_FAILED__; fi; exit 0

AM_OP=moveOrFail; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; AM_Q='/sdcard/Приклад тека/новий (1).txt'; if [ -e "$AM_Q" ]; then echo __AM_EXISTS__; exit 0; fi; mv -- "$AM_P" "$AM_Q" 2>/dev/null; if [ ! -e "$AM_Q" ]; then echo __AM_MV_FAILED__; fi; exit 0
AM_OP=existsProbe; AM_P='/sdcard/Приклад тека/it'\''s файл й.txt'; if [ -e "$AM_P" ]; then echo __AM_EXISTS__; else echo __AM_ABSENT__; fi; exit 0

AM_OP=rescanPaths; AM_F='/sdcard/a b.jpg'; am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d "file://$AM_F" >/dev/null 2>&1; AM_F='/sdcard/o'\''clock.mp4'; am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d "file://$AM_F" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo __AM_SCAN_DONE__; exit 0
AM_OP=rescanVolume; content call --uri content://media/external/file --method scan_volume --arg external_primary >/dev/null 2>&1; echo __AM_SCAN_DONE__; exit 0

AM_OP=getProps; printf '__AM_ID__|%s
' "$(settings get secure android_id 2>/dev/null)"; printf '__AM_SN__|%s
' "$(getprop ro.serialno 2>/dev/null)"; printf '__AM_MODEL__|%s
' "$(getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null)"; exit 0
